slides.texte_overlay:
10 things I wish I knew
at a young age

1.
People forget your mistakes
faster than you do.

2.
Your first job won't be your last.
Learn everything you can.

3.
Your parents' advice makes sense
around 30. Listen earlier.

4.
Showing up beats talent
most of the time.

5.
Curiosity keeps you young.
Learn one thing every day.
slides.texte_sophia:
5.
Curiosity keeps you young.
I learn one thing a day
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
6.
Real friends are rare.
Keep the ones you have.

7.
You don't need to have it
all figured out.

8.
Mornings shape your life
more than nights.

9.
Comparison steals your joy.

10.
Start before you feel ready.
